edges.reason: msg.sender from the fallback becomes the beneficiary passed into buyTokens
Payable fallback forwards execution to buyTokens(_msgSender())
beneficiary parameter governs validation and token delivery in buyTokens
beneficiary determines the token recipient inside _processPurchase
weiAmount local is derived from msg.value at the start of buyTokens
weiAmount is multiplied by rate to compute the token amount
_rate is used in the multiplication inside _getTokenAmount
_getTokenAmount returns the value stored in the tokens local
_weiRaised is incremented with SafeMath add of weiAmount
tokens local is passed to _processPurchase for delivery
_processPurchase invokes _deliverTokens
_token state variable is the token transferred in _deliverTokens
safeTransfer routes into callOptionalReturn's low-level external call
callOptionalReturn performs an unchecked low-level call to the token address
buyTokens calls _forwardFunds after purchase processing
_wallet receives the forwarded purchase value
_forwardFunds performs the external _wallet.transfer call to the funds destination
sendValue performs an arbitrary value-bearing low-level call to recipient
Constructor assigns the validated rate argument to _rate
Constructor assigns the validated wallet argument to _wallet
Constructor assigns the validated token argument to _token
nonReentrant modifier reads and writes the _notEntered guard flag around buyTokens
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance via _approve
_balances entries are modified with SafeMath sub and add in _transfer
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances
_mint increases the recipient balance with SafeMath add
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath add
_burn decreases the account balance with SafeMath sub
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath sub
_msgSender (msg.sender) is the account whose tokens transfer moves
_msgSender (msg.sender) is the spender whose allowance is consumed

normalization_plan.reason: beneficiary is a user-supplied parameter whose only role is to parameterise buyTokens and its downstream token delivery; it should be folded into the buyTokens function node.
weiAmount is a transient local copy of msg.value passed directly into the token amount conversion; it should be merged into the _getTokenAmount function node.
tokens is an intermediate local produced by the rate multiplication and consumed by the purchase processing routine; it should be merged into the _processPurchase function node.
